First 1 second silent
Age: In his/her 60s
Personality: Refined, gentle

■ Direction
Nemea, Lerna: Two of the locations Hercules traveled to during his Twelve Labors

To the faint voice of prayer that reached my ears—
I shall answer, "Something like that."
Now, doubt order! Cast aside your reason!

Then I shall guide you, O wandering lamb!
Let these purifying flames cleanse all your hesitation, all your sins!

Fret not, for rebirth lies strictly on the flipside of destruction.
Not even the hound of the underworld can stay the hand that wields my hammer.

Listen here, just fixing it yourself doesn't make it okay.
Earning money for materials is tough enough as it is... Are you even listening to me?!

As I watched Tanino Gimlet continue to serve customers impeccably
all while laughing haughtily—
Customer, take this.

Having messed up at work,
I was sighing at the counter of a bar and restaurant one night.
Ghaaa-ha-ha-ha-haaa!
And to Tanino Gimlet—destruction.

Are you listening to me?!
Do you have any idea how much repairs cost!

Before I knew it, I had completely forgotten about my gloom...
And by the time my mocktail was empty, my sighs had vanished without a trace.
If that's the case, I'll gratefully take a sip. And then—
A problem child who frequently skips class for reasons no one can fathom—

A martini gets a lemon peel,
a gin and tonic gets a lime slice.

...Pardon her, customer. She might seem eccentric, but she's quite attentive.
She probably just couldn't ignore seeing you look so down in the dumps.

...Heheheh...! Ghaaa-ha-ha-ha!
Small wonder you are startled, but I heard a sigh that begged for inebriation!
Ghaaa-ha-ha-ha-ha-haaa!

The finishing kick is still half-baked.
There's room for improvement in the sharpness of the opening dash as well—I see.
Ah, though God beckons, I shall not return!
—Ngh, DAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

Behold, this celestial radiance. The contrast woven with the dark.
Standing silently amidst swirling dust—the forbidden fruit.

Still, you are a server.
How many times must I tell you not to make mocktails on your—

It seemed Tanino Gimlet was a problem child
who frequently destroyed fences on campus, and—

Just what was she talking about? As I stood there bewildered...
the owner watching nearby took pity and stepped in to help.

Tanino Gimlet!
How many times must I tell you not to break the fences!
(KABOOM!)

Now, drink it dry, burn everything away!
Let sin be judged, and a new gateway shall be granted unto thee!

Whether she heard the owner's scolding or not...
Tanino Gimlet walked away with a resounding cackle.

Hmph! I shall face any trial as many times as it takes!
Now, onward first to Nemea! And then to Lerna!
Just get back here already!

On the other hand, when it came to training alone, she was utterly devoted...
She seemed to be that kind of Umamusume.

To bring about intoxication at all times and in all places. That is my
potential, my—Tanino Gimlet's very craftsmanship!

I picked up the glass placed before me for now.
The girl presenting the mocktail seemed to be a staff member here.

...It appears she made it for you.
She wants you to drink it so you can regain your vigor.

It shall be etched into the hearts of students passing by...!
—That the bringer of light has descended upon the ruins...!

Tsk, tsk, tsk...!
A poor proposal, mademoiselle.
In that case, for Tanino Gimlet—

—An original mocktail inspired by the breath of the abyss...
"The Divine Comedy."

Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!
...Good grief, so this is where you were! Get back to class immediately!

...Haah, haah, haah... phew! ...Hmph, not bad.
However, form is meaningless unless it becomes second nature.
...Ngh, haah, haah, haah!

It was a refreshing mocktail reminiscent of a tropical vacation,
characterized by citrusy sweetness, tartness, and a touch of pomegranate.

......Sin. It is the secret seasoning of reincarnation.
A drop of garnish that alters even the scenario of destiny...

Naturally!
For I, myself, am the one who blended it!

Afterward, I saw her on campus.
It turned out Tanino Gimlet was a student at Tracen Academy, and—
